svg.aria-label: A TRISO fuel element in three zooms. One: a hexagonal graphite block about 36 centimetres across, drilled with fuel holes and helium coolant channels. Two: one fuel compact from a fuel hole, a graphite pellet about 12 millimetres wide holding thousands of tiny particles. Three: one particle, just under one millimetre, cut open to show a uranium kernel of about 0.4 millimetres inside four layers: a porous carbon buffer that gives gas room, an inner carbon layer, a silicon carbide shell that holds the fission products in, and an outer carbon layer.
svg.text: just under 1 mm, a poppy seed
